edges.reason: balanceOf reads the reflection balance of the account to derive token balance.
_transferStandard reads and writes _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam adds reflection team fee into the contract reflection balance.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotalAmt and performs reflection supply arithmetic.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotalAmt.
_reflectFee adds the token fee into _tFeeTotalAmt.
_getValues uses _feeForAddr1 as tax fee numerator.
_getValues uses _feeForAddr2 as team fee numerator.
sendETHToFee transfers ETH to the marketing wallet state variable.
The marketing wallet address is the target of the ETH transfer call.
swapTokensForEth invokes the stored Uniswap router instance.
openTrading assigns and uses the uniswapV2Router state variable.
_transfer compares from/to against the uniswapV2Pair address.
openTrading requires tradingOpen to be false before initialising trading.
The inSwap flag guards the swap/ETH distribution block during transfers.
swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
openTrading overwrites _maxTxAmount with the full total supply.
onlyOwner modifier checks _owner equals the caller before openTrading executes.
onlyOwner gate protects renounceOwnership and its _owner write.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source of the token movement.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance deduction.
_transfer receives msg.sender (via transfer/transferFrom) as the from address.
openTrading is restricted to the owner derived from msg.sender.
_approve writes allowances for msg.sender as owner or spender.
The constructor permanently sets _owner from msg.sender.
renounceOwnership caller identity is verified against _owner.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.
approve writes the allowance via _approve.
_transfer ends by calling _tokenTransfer with the resolved addresses.
_transfer triggers an external swap call while executing transfer logic.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to an external address during execution.
_transfer reads the contract token balance via balanceOf before swapping.
swapTokensForEth approves the router before swapping.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfer call to the marketing wallet.
openTrading approves the router to spend the total supply.
openTrading calls the factory to create the token/WETH pair.
openTrading calls the router addLiquidityETH with contract ETH.
openTrading reads the contract token balance to seed liquidity.
_tokenTransfer forwards to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard forwards the computed team fee to _takeTeam.
_transferStandard passes fee values to _reflectFee for supply math.
_takeTeam fetches the reflection rate from _getRate.
_reflectFee mutates _rTotalAmt with subtraction of the fee.
_reflectFee mutates _tFeeTotalAmt with addition of the fee.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token amount breakdown.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amount breakdown.
_getValues reads the current reflection rate.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply outputs.
balanceOf converts the reflection balance via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides by the current rate from _getRate.
tokenFromReflection requires the input to be at most _rTotalAmt.
The transfer recipient parameter flows into transfer.
The transfer amount parameter flows into transfer.
The transferFrom sender parameter flows into transferFrom.
The transferFrom recipient parameter flows into transferFrom.
The transferFrom amount parameter is used for the transfer and allowance subtraction.
The from parameter is validated and used for tax logic in _transfer.
The to parameter is validated and used for tax logic in _transfer.
The amount parameter flows through _transfer into _tokenTransfer.
tokenAmount parameter drives the swap in swapTokensForEth.
tokenAmount is supplied as amountIn to the external router swap call.
amount parameter is the value transferred in sendETHToFee.
amount parameter is forwarded to the marketing wallet transfer call.
owner parameter indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping in _approve.
amount parameter is stored into the allowance mapping.
sender parameter is debited in _transferStandard.
recipient parameter is credited in _transferStandard.
tAmount parameter is the basis for reflection calculations.
The path local array is populated and used for the router swap.
contractTokenBalance is computed and passed to swapTokensForEth.
contractETHBalance is computed from the contract balance in _transfer.
The local router instance is assigned to uniswapV2Router in openTrading.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer recipient parameter is fully resolved by the transfer function signature.
transfer amount parameter is fully resolved by the transfer function signature.
transferFrom sender parameter belongs to the transferFrom function.
transferFrom recipient parameter belongs to the transferFrom function.
transferFrom amount parameter belongs to the transferFrom function.
from parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer.
amount parameter is consumed by _transfer and its callees.
tokenAmount is resolved by swapTokensForEth and its swap call.
amount is resolved by sendETHToFee before the wallet transfer.
owner parameter is resolved by _approve allowance write.
spender parameter is resolved by _approve allowance write.
amount parameter is resolved by _approve allowance write.
sender parameter is resolved by _transferStandard balance update.
recipient parameter is resolved by _transferStandard balance update.
tAmount parameter is resolved by _transferStandard reflection math.
path local array is only used within swapTokensForEth.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary inside _transfer feeding the swap call.
contractETHBalance is a temporary that is forwarded to the ETH fee transfer.
local router instance is a temporary confined to openTrading.
